legacy_payload.visual_direction: realistic whiteboard explanation slide, marker handwriting, sketched diagrams, friendly teaching atmosphere, authentic whiteboard details

canvas.background: warm off-white whiteboard surface #FAFAF5 with subtle marker smudges
canvas.composition: freeform but organized whiteboard layout with title, three concept blocks, arrows, and small doodle illustrations
canvas.density: moderate, readable, brainstorming feel without chaos

color_palette.rule: colors should look like real marker ink, not digital neon
color_palette.secondary: whiteboard white #FFFFFF surface, gray marker #9AA3AB secondary strokes

typography.title: large neat handwritten Chinese marker style (霞鹜文楷 LXGW WenKai for Chinese, Caveat for Latin)
typography.body: clear handwritten marker text, slightly irregular but readable
typography.emphasis: circle, underline, boxed words, sticky-note comments
typography.text_quality: Chinese handwriting must remain accurate and legible
typography.labels: marker labels (马克笔手写体 / Caveat), circled emphasis and underline strokes

layout_patterns: three hand-drawn boxes connected by arrows
central concept bubble with surrounding notes
simple process diagram with sketches and annotations
left explanation list plus right hand-drawn diagram
legacy_payload.layout_usage_rule: Use layout_blueprints as candidate starting points only. Choose and adapt the composition according to each slide's semantic role; avoid repeating the same blueprint on adjacent slides unless it is a deliberate repeated sequence.

visual_elements.allowed: whiteboard frame, marker tray, colored markers, arrows, boxes, clouds, sticky notes, doodle icons, underlines, circled keywords, wobbly curved connector arrows with double-line emphasis, sticky notes with torn-tape edges and slight rotation
visual_elements.avoid: messy illegible handwriting, childish clutter, photoreal people, digital UI cards

negative_prompt: digital neon colors, or more than four marker hues on one slide, instead of real marker ink
perfectly straight ruler lines and crisp vector-clean geometric shapes
rendering_constraints: The slide should look like a real whiteboard captured cleanly for a presentation.
Keep all Chinese text readable despite handwritten style.
Color fills do not completely fill their outlines — leave loose marker-block gaps that preserve hand-drawn looseness.
Every line carries a slight hand-drawn wobble; connectors flow as wavy hand-drawn strokes, never ruler-straight.
Icons stay conceptual and abstract doodles rather than realistic scenes.
Colored marker annotations stay within 4 hues on screen per slide (marker ink discipline).
A single bold centered takeaway line may sit at the page bottom.
No watermark, no unrelated logo, no slide number unless explicitly requested.
